# Northwind Relay security policy

Report a security issue in Northwind Relay to security@relay.example.com, which acknowledges it within 3 working days and discloses it under a 90-day timeline.

## Reporting a vulnerability

To report a security issue, please email security@relay.example.com with a description of the issue, the steps you took to create the issue, affected versions, and, if known, mitigations for the issue. The security team acknowledges your email within 3 working days and tells you whether the issue is confirmed within 10 working days.

## Disclosure policy

This project follows a 90 day disclosure timeline. During it the team confirms the issue, prepares the fix, requests a CVE identifier through GitHub, and drafts the advisory. You are credited in the advisory by name and affiliation unless you ask not to be. When a fix needs longer than 90 days, the team tells you the new date before the timeline ends.

## Security updates

Fixes ship in the newest supported version line first and are announced as GitHub security advisories at https://github.com/example/relay/security/advisories and in the release notes at https://relay.example.com/releases.
